_comment: Drift guardrail — see scripts/check-file-sizes.mjs. Each entry freezes a known-oversized source file at its current line count: the file may SHRINK freely but may not GROW past the recorded number. New source files must stay under the 1000-line ceiling. This list IS the target roster for ROADMAP Track B6 (god-file splits); as B6 lands, shrink or delete entries. Bumping a number up is a deliberate, reviewed act — don't do it to dodge a split.
